## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls.
